newsitem.title: GERMANY: German floor trade to resume at 1115 GMT.
newsitem.headline: German floor trade to resume at 1115 GMT.

text.p: The German bourse said on Wednesday that floor trade in stocks, bonds and other financial instruments would resume again at 1115 GMT after trading was shut down due to technical problems.
A spokesman for the bourse told Reuters that floor trading hours would be extended this session, closing at 1230 GMT instead of the usual 1130 GMT.
The bourse also said that the IBIS computer share trading system was currently being tested, adding that it was unclear when full trade on this system would start.
Trade on the DTB futures exchange was not suspended, and had continued through Wednesday morning, the bourse said earlier.
